data:
This course provides an overview of the following topics: Calculus (Limits, Continuity, Basic
 Overview of Differential and Integral Calculus with Applications that involve modelling, and Differential
 Equations). Multivariable Calculus: Derivatives, partial derivatives, differentiation with respect to a vector;
 gradient, Hessian, Jacobian. Taylor's theorem in 1 and n dimensions, with Lagrange remainder.
 Optimization in 1 and n dimensions, classification of stationary points. Constrained optimization and the
 method of Lagrange multipliers.
